market.name: Oakton Luxury Market
market.subhead: Nothing is currently active in this segment — every home that sold, sold successfully, and the only competition is already under contract.

notes: Local context on the two nearby sales. 3206 Wheatland Farms Dr sold recently as-is, on a markedly inferior lot with little updating. 3204 Wheatland Farms Dr sold for $1,828,000 in May 2024, and is neither a flat nor a private lot. Neither one carries this home’s lot or its level of improvement.
